content: Standard dosage guidelines for common medications: Warfarin 2-10 mg daily, titrated to INR 2-3 for most indications. Metformin 500-2000 mg daily in divided doses. Lisinopril 10-40 mg daily for hypertension. Atorvastatin 10-80 mg daily for hyperlipidemia. Amlodipine 5-10 mg daily for hypertension. Levothyroxine 25-200 mcg daily based on TSH. Omeprazole 20-40 mg daily for GERD. Sertraline 25-200 mg daily for depression. Gabapentin 300-3600 mg daily in divided doses. Prednisone 5-60 mg daily depending on condition. Furosemide 20-80 mg daily for edema. Allopurinol 100-300 mg daily for gout. Doses should be individualized based on patient factors.
